title: Stealing an ambulance in GTA 6 did not end well #gta6 #shorts
description: My own GTA 6 gameplay: an ambulance escape down Vice City Beach. (Champs Network)

scenes.say: I picked the worst getaway car in Vice City.
A stolen ambulance, on the sand, with the cops right behind me.
Five stars and the whole beach watching.
Dodging lifeguard towers like it's a racing game.
Guess how this ended. Wrong answers only.
